prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: kubcode editorial article cover, second in a cohesive three-image series.
Primary request: an orderly open shallow toolbox or tray holding five tidy sculptural objects: an unbranded plug, a small gear, a sound-wave token made of curved concentric ridges, a folded abstract ribbon shape suggesting typography but resembling no letter or glyph, and a small key. Each object has a tiny blank tag or plain circular seal attached. One translucent closed padlock stands beside the tray to suggest permissions and reassurance.
Style/medium: refined soft 3D editorial illustration, layered frosted lavender glass and satin paper materials, clean deliberate geometry. Match a series featuring translucent glowing film and soft lavender sculptural objects.
Scene/backdrop: seamless deep purple to near-black background, #100e15 and #2c1549, subtle ground shadow.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9, slightly elevated three-quarter view. Entire toolbox and objects grouped compactly in the right two-thirds. Leave the LEFT third completely quiet with dark negative space. All subjects fully inside the central 75% of image height and comfortably away from edges for a slightly shorter wide crop.
Lighting/mood: broad soft directional light from upper left, gentle lavender glow, very restrained warm highlight, calm considered reassuring.
Color palette: deep purple and near-black, lavender #bb98ff and #d1b9ff, consistent monochromatic purple series.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, readable glyphs, logos, brands, watermark, UI chrome, screenshots, people, faces, or named artist imitation. All tags and seals are blank. No checkmarks or other writing. No harsh artifacts. Render a polished landscape illustration.
